30–45 min (then 5–10 min per day for the task)

A rock formation was discovered northwest of Darashia. You collect a flower and holy water, pass the three lion trials to enter the Inner Sanctum and translate four ancient inscriptions that reveal a colour riddle. After that, every day you can place four gems in a room of the sanctuary to make a fountain appear with a random reward, including {item:The Lion's Heart}, which lets you tame the Noble Lion.
A rock formation has been discovered northwest of Darashia.
only for the mission (Lion's Strength test)
Random reward from the well (every 24 hours): {item:The Lion's Heart}, {item:Gold Ingot}, {item:Yellow Gem}, {item:Red Gem}, {item:Giant Shimmering Pearl (Brown)} or {item:Emerald Bangle}
Permanent access to the Lion's Rock Inner Sanctum
When you pass the three lion trials: walk through the {item:Mystic Flame} on the west side of the trials floor.
Permanent access: afterwards you enter without repeating the trials.
Daily task of the gem fountain
After entering the Inner Sanctum and translating the four inscriptions.
Once every 24 hours; random reward, which can be {item:The Lion's Heart} (to tame a {creature:Noble Lion}).
That part requires you to have done the Lion's Rock Quest up to the point where you get access to the temple.
Kill a few {creature:Cobra|Cobras} on the way (or buy one) to get the {item:Cobra Tongue}.
Bring the four small stones (ruby, sapphire, topaz, amethyst) the very first time so you can do the task right after the mission.
Other players can use the well you revealed: do not do the task with someone you do not trust nearby.
1. Collect the flower and the holy water

Go to **Darashia** (for example, by magic carpet from Edron with {npc:Pino}, or by boat). Leave the city to the **west-northwest** to **Lion's Rock**, a rock formation near Darashia's portal to the Gnomebase.
Explore the surface part of the rock and climb the stairs inside and outside the mountain. On the upper floors you find a planted {item:Lion's Mane Flower}: use it to get a {item:Lion's Mane Flower}.
Planted Lion's Mane Flower on the upper floors
The upper floors also have a {item:Well With a Lion-like Face|well with a lion's face}. Use it to get an {item:Ewer with Holy Water} (*“You took some holy water from the sacred well.”*).
You cannot take holy water from the well more than once in a short period (about 1 day).
2. Go down to the cave and read the parchment

With both items, go to the underground cave. Near the start you find a {item:Dead Explorer} (corpse). Use it to get an {item:Lion's Rock Three Tests (Book)|Old Parchment}, which talks about the three tests. If you need to leave before reaching the Inner Sanctum, go back to the surface the same way you came down.
This floor has tunnels leading to small rooms with fairly weak undead. You have to pass the 3 tests; the order does not matter. In each one, a {item:Small Pagoda} lights up when you pass.
The three tests are at these points: 1) northwest, 2) northeast (just east of the first), 3) southwest.

Find the {item:Slightly Feline Statue} and use the {item:Cobra Tongue} on it. The Small Pagoda lights up: *“You have sacrificed a cobra tongue at an ancient statue. The light in the small pyramid nearby begins to shine.”*
Find the {item:Ornamented Stone Pedestal} and pour the {item:Ewer with Holy Water} over it. The Small Pagoda lights up: *“You have purified a sacred pedestal with holy water...”*
Find the {item:Coal Basin} and burn the {item:Lion's Mane Flower} in it. The Small Pagoda lights up: *“You burnt a lion's mane flower. The light in the small pyramid nearby begins to shine.”*

Once the 3 tests are done you receive *“You have passed the Lion's Tests and are now worthy to enter the inner sanctum!”*. Walk through the {item:Mystic Flame} on the **west** side of this floor to enter the Inner Sanctum.
Mystic Flame to the Inner Sanctum
After this you can enter as many times as you like without repeating the tests.

On the second floor there are {creature:Ancient Scarab|Ancient Scarabs} and {creature:Roaring Lion|Roaring Lions}. The floor is split into 3 parts, connected by small tunnels on the floor below. You start in the middle part. You have to pick up a Translation Scroll and walk past 4 inscriptions.
The first point is the amphora with the scroll; the other four are the inscriptions to translate.

Go **west** and **north** and go down the hole. Walk **north** and go up. Then walk **north** and run past the {item:Large Amphora} in the middle of the room: it crumbles and you receive a {item:Translation Scroll} (*“As you pass incautiously, the ancient amphora crumbles to shards and dust. Amidst the debris you discover an old scroll.”*).
From here on, the scroll activates by itself when you are in the right place, with a white server message.
You receive the Translation Scroll a few seconds after breaking the amphora

From the start, go **southeast**. Go down the stairs and climb the stairs at the south end of the tunnel: you are in the southeast part. Go to the **westernmost** tip of this area (south and then west of the stairs) until you reach the {item:Hyaena Statue}. Message: *“[...] the mighty lion defeated the greedy hyaena. As a sign of victory he took its blood, red as voracity and lust [...]”*
Stairs up (south end of the tunnel)
Walk past the Hyaena Statue to translate the 1st inscription

From the statue, go back **northeast** and go down. Climb the stairs at the end of the tunnel to return to the middle part. The egg inscription, a {item:Carved Stone Tile (Lizard)}, is in the **northeast** of this area. Message: *“[...] the mighty lion defeated the lazy lizard. As a sign of victory he took its egg, blue as sloth and conceit [...]”*
Walk past the lizard inscription on the floor to translate the 2nd inscription

From the egg inscription, go to the **northwesternmost** part of the floor. Go down the stairs and follow the tunnel **north**. Climb the stairs to reach the northwest part. The snake inscription, a {item:Snake Ornament}, is on the **north** side of this area. Message: *“[...] the mighty lion defeated the jealous snake. As a sign of victory he took its eye, yellow as envy and malevolence [...]”*
Walk past the snake inscription on the floor to translate the 3rd inscription

In the middle part, to the **southwest**, is the {item:Scorpion Altar}. Message: *“[...] the mighty lion defeated the treacherous scorpion. As a sign of victory he took its poison, violet as deceit and betrayal [...]”*. The inscriptions give the solution to the next puzzle: the colours **red, blue, yellow and violet**.
Walk past the golden altar to translate the 4th inscription
Once you have access to the Inner Sanctum and have translated the inscriptions, you can do this task every **24 hours** (not 20, like most) to receive a random reward.

In the **northwest** part of the Inner Sanctum, find the rectangular room to the **south**, in the southwest. It has 4 "sun" inscriptions on the floor (sockets for gems) and a rock in the centre. Look at each tile to see what it represents.
Each gem has to be used on the right socket to light it up
Use each gem on the matching socket ({item:Stone Tile with a Socket (Hyaena's Maw)|Stone Tile with a Socket}). Each one lights a flame of the right colour:
On the last gem you receive *“[...] Something happens at the center of the room ...”*.

With all 4 gems in place, a bubbling {item:Ornamented Fountain} appears in the centre of the room, where the rocks were. Use it to receive the random reward (*“Something sparkles in the fountain's water. You draw out a beautiful and certainly precious amulet.”*).

If you already have the {wiki:Noble Lion (Mount)|Noble Lion} mount, you cannot receive {item:The Lion's Heart}. You can still spend the gems and reveal the fountain, but if there is no reward you get *“At the moment there is neither a treasure nor anything else in the fountain. Perhaps you might return later.”*

If you received {item:The Lion's Heart}, you can tame a {creature:Noble Lion}. Go **north** from the gem room and follow the tunnel **west** to a crossroads. Turn **east** and go down the stairs to the lion temple (*“You enter a temple area which is gorgeously decorated [...]”*). Here there are only {creature:Roaring Lion|Roaring Lions} and {creature:Noble Lion|Noble Lions}.

The wiki does not describe a shortcut out of the Inner Sanctum. Go back the way you came to the {item:Mystic Flame} area on the first underground floor, climb to the surface by the cave path and return to Darashia, to the **east-southeast**.
On the way back you pass {creature:Ancient Scarab|Ancient Scarabs} (which paralyse) and {creature:Roaring Lion|Roaring Lions} again.
The fountain task can be repeated every 24 hours.
Other players can use the fountain you revealed.
